docs.summary: Binds to a device, discovering each pass's variant axes via the compiler. OnDemand compiles variants as requested; All compiles everything up front. If a requested variant isn't compiled yet or failed, falls back to the fallback variant instead of throwing. Fallback must itself have a compiled description for the active backend, or resolving throws anyway.
